title: On the SoS Certifiability of Log-Concave Distributions
summary: We prove that for every isotropic log-concave distribution $P$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ and every even $m\ge2$, the polynomial $(Cm)^m\|v\|_2^m - \mathbb{E}_{X\sim P}\langle X,v\rangle^m$ is a sum of squares, where $C>0$ is a universal constant. This improves on the Poincaré-dependent bounds (Kothari and Steinhardt, 2017), recovering the optimal moment bounds for log-concave distributions. As an immediate corollary, we obtain computationally efficient algorithms with dimension-free error guarantees for a wide range of statistical estimation problems.
